FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(WESTERN KUALA LUMPUR TRAFFIC DISPERSAL SCHEME HIGHWAYKERINCHI LINK

AND DAMANSARA LINK) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 3) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of

the Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Western Kuala Lumpur Traffic Dispersal Scheme

HighwayKerinchi Link and Damansara Link) (Amendment) (No. 3) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2015.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Western Kuala

Lumpur Traffic Dispersal Scheme HighwayKerinchi Link and Damansara Link)

Order 2001 [P. U. (A) 274/2001], which is referred to as the "principal Order"

in this Order, is amended in the subparagraph 2(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "column (2) of Parts I to IV of the

Second Schedule according to the concession years," the words

"column (2) of the Second Schedule"; and

(b) by substituting for the words "column (1) of Parts I to IV" the words

"column (1)".

Substitution of Second Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the Second Schedule the

following Schedule:
